steps.note: The standalone workflow's step: `npx -y @hawkeyexl/manni meta validate "**/*.md" --format github`, run locally.
Let the config file supply the paths: `manni meta validate --format github` with no targets reads `collections:`.
Gate one part of the docs set: `--collection guides --format github`.
Verify it works: with a file missing `type`, `--format github` locally prints the raw `::error` lines and the gate fails.
Drop the flag to get the readable pretty report: `npx -y @hawkeyexl/manni meta validate "docs/**/*.md"`.

must_not: Treat creating .github/workflows/manni.yml, committing, pushing, or opening a pull request as runnable steps. The job and its PR annotations exist only on GitHub.
scaffolding: docs/intro.md and docs/guides/setup.md both pass the built-in OKF schema. manni.config.yaml declares collections `pages` (docs/*.md) and `guides` (docs/guides/**/*.md), so the bare and `--collection guides` runs have targets. No file is missing `type` at the start: the page has the reader introduce one to see the gate fire, so a spec writes it before the `::error` and pretty runs.
